claim_definition: Verifies that Only OS produces a real Groth16 BN254 zkSNARK proof over the ComplianceSquare circuit: the prover demonstrates knowledge of a compliance score s such that s² equals a public commitment, without revealing s. The arkworks ark-groth16 0.6 crate performs real trusted setup, proving, and pairing-based verification. A tampered public input (wrong commitment) is rejected by the verifier.
scope: Only OS ZKP compliance export path; Groth16 BN254 proof system; privacy-preserving audit for regulated industries
excluded_scope: Full on-chain SNARK anchoring; ZKP latency certification; recursive proofs

test_cases.description: Real Groth16 BN254 zkSNARK: only-gate runs trusted setup for the ComplianceSquare circuit (score²=commitment), generates a real proof that score=42 satisfies 42²=1764, and verifies with the honest public commitment. The verifier never learns score=42.

Tampered public input: the valid proof is verified against commitment+1 (wrong value). The BN254 pairing check fails, proving tamper-evidence. No proof generated for a different witness can satisfy the wrong commitment.
